title: Misleading comment: spec says computed SF, code hardcodes 12
description:
File: python/src/lichen/ccp.py:224

Comment claims 'Per spec: utilization > 200 forces SF=12' but spec pseudocode says RETURN (SF, false) - the computed SF, not hardcoded 12.

**Failure scenario:** For assigned_sf=7, utilization=201: code returns SF=12 (hardcoded) but spec pseudocode step 5 says to return computed SF which would be 10. Test vectors expect 12, but comment incorrectly cites spec authority.

**Verdict:** PLAUSIBLE
